subject: Code review: Changes requested for AMSD-2041

body.text: Code review identified issues that need to be addressed.

issues.description: No unit tests were added for the new live_preview configuration. The diff adds 7 lines to src/services/contentstack.ts but no corresponding test file (e.g., src/services/__tests__/contentstack.spec.ts) verifies that the options object includes live_preview with the correct management_token, host, and enable fields. Per review criteria, new features must have corresponding unit tests mirroring the src/ path. There are zero tests verifying that live_preview.management_token equals CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_TOKEN, that enable is true when the token is set, or that enable is false when the token is empty.
issues.suggestedFix: Add test cases to src/services/__tests__/contentstack.spec.ts verifying: (1) options.live_preview.management_token equals CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_TOKEN, (2) options.live_preview.enable is true when token is set, (3) options.live_preview.enable is false when token is empty, (4) options.live_preview.host equals CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_HOST.

issues.description: When CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_TOKEN is empty, live preview is silently disabled (enable evaluates to false) with no warning or error logged. The acceptance criterion states: 'When the draft preview cannot be displayed, the editor sees a clear error or unavailable state in the preview area rather than published content being silently shown as if it were the draft.' The existing code logs errors for missing CONTENTSTACK_API_KEY, CONTENTSTACK_DELIVERY_TOKEN, CONTENTSTACK_ENVIRONMENT, and CONTENTSTACK_BRANCH, but no equivalent warning exists for the missing preview token. An operator or editor will see published content with no indication that draft preview is unavailable.
issues.suggestedFix: Add a logger.warn() when CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_TOKEN is empty, similar to the existing pattern for other missing env vars. Example: if (!CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_TOKEN) { logger.warn('Contentstack preview token not provided — live preview disabled'); }

issues.description: The ContentstackProvider still uses useMemo to freeze content at initial render time. Even with the SDK-level live_preview config now correctly added to the Stack options, the React context never updates after mount. The Contentstack SDK's live preview mechanism sends updated content via callbacks/events, but nothing in the codebase registers a listener (e.g., Stack.livePreview.onContentUpdate) to call a setContent function and trigger re-renders. Without this, acceptance criterion 2 ('previewed page updates to show the new value without the editor publishing the entry') and criterion 5 ('content visible in the preview matches the draft state the editor is currently editing') are unmet. The prescribed minimal fix only covers the SDK options layer; however, the acceptance criteria explicitly require real-time reactive updates, which the SDK config alone cannot deliver without a React-side listener.
issues.suggestedFix: Replace useMemo with useState in ContentstackProvider to hold content state. Register the Contentstack SDK's livePreview callback (Stack.livePreview.onContentUpdate or equivalent from @contentstack/live-preview-utils) to call setContent with updated content when the CMS editor changes a field. Pass the updated content through the context so all 236+ consumers via useContent re-render with draft content.

issues.description: The new environment variables CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_TOKEN and CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_HOST are not documented in .env.local.sample. The diff to .env.local.sample only adds AKAMAI_CACHE_ENABLED and AKAMAI_MAX_CACHE_SECONDS (from a different story). The two new preview-related env vars are missing entirely, making it difficult for developers to discover and configure live preview.
issues.suggestedFix: Add CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_TOKEN="" and CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_HOST="" to .env.local.sample alongside the existing CONTENTSTACK_* entries.

issues.description: The ternary `CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_TOKEN ? true : false` can be simplified to `!!CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_TOKEN` for conciseness. This is a style nit.
